einvoice 0.1.0-preview.1.102+f1fb22eec3caa4a003b518e0f0601073aa86d3a3 — electronic invoices, from the command line.

  einvoice validate <file|directory>...   check against every rule set that applies
  einvoice inspect  <file|directory>...   what is it, and what did reading it report
  einvoice convert  <file> --to ubl|cii   carry it across, and say what that cost
  einvoice profiles                       the profiles this build knows
  einvoice rules                          the rule sets it can judge with

Options
  --rules <file|directory>   add Schematron, source or compiled, that we may not ship
  --strict | --lenient       how hard reading should be on a document
  --json                     machine-readable report (validate)
  --quiet                    only what failed (validate)
  --out <file>               write there instead of standard output (convert)

Exit codes: 0 conforming, 1 rejected or unchecked, 2 could not run.

UBL, CII, Factur-X PDFs and lifecycle messages. EN 16931, XRechnung, France,
Germany and Belgium are built in; artefacts that may not be redistributed are
fetched — see build/fetch-specs.sh — and pointed at with --rules.
